name: Sameer Sattar
bio: Barrister Sameer Sattar leads the firm's corporate and dispute resolution practice, advising domestic and multinational clients on high-value transactions, banking litigation and international arbitration. He is regularly recognised by the leading legal directories for his work in the technology, media, telecommunications, aviation, energy and employment sectors.

name: Mamun Chowdhury
bio: Mamun Chowdhury advises on banking, finance and corporate advisory matters, drawing on a long-standing practice before Bangladesh's commercial courts.

name: Rafiqul Alam
bio: Rafiqul Alam brings decades of litigation experience, with a particular focus on admiralty and shipping-related commercial disputes.

name: Md. Yadnan Rafique Rossy
bio: Yadnan Rafique Rossy advises corporate clients on regulatory compliance and day-to-day corporate governance matters.

name: Md. Khademul Islam Choyon
bio: Khademul Islam Choyon works on corporate transactions and M&A mandates for domestic and international clients.

name: Mahbub Hasan
bio: Mahbub Hasan focuses on commercial disputes and banking litigation before the Supreme Court of Bangladesh.

name: Mariha Zaman Khan
bio: Mariha Zaman Khan advises on employment and general corporate matters for local and multinational employers.

name: Sajid Hossain
bio: Sajid Hossain works on energy and project finance mandates, including power purchase agreements and project documentation.

name: Tareq Hasan
bio: Tareq Hasan supports the firm's advisory teams with legal research across regulatory and transactional matters.

name: Sadat Islam
bio: Sadat Islam supports litigation and arbitration teams with case research and preparation.

name: Francis Gomes
bio: Francis Gomes oversees the firm's administrative and office management functions.

name: Martin Pritom Gomes
bio: Martin Pritom Gomes manages daily office operations and administrative coordination.

name: Palash Sarker
bio: Palash Sarker supports the firm's administrative and clerical operations.
